topic: Data extraction and frequency calculation methods
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered multiple data extraction and analytics topics. Initially, questions arose regarding opening a cluster for campaigns in the Ouseen area (Denmark) and the lack of available demographics/options. Later, the focus shifted to retrieving historical raw device data for a single company over one month from archives.

Multiple SQL queries were shared and refined for calculating traffic metrics and frequency. The final exchange involved querying package-level data (`_pkg_7600_202309`) to count daily packages, which was requested by someone who needed hourly packet counts.
decisions: The initial query regarding campaign clustering in Ouseen (Denmark) could not be completed due to missing options and demographics.
SQL queries were provided for calculating traffic metrics and frequency at different stages (stage campaigns, stage dashboards, traffic query).
action_items: Someone will re-extract package data to provide hourly packet counts.
